query: How do I make avocado toast?

goal.title: Make seasoned mashed-avocado bread
goal.description: Halve and pit an avocado, scoop its flesh onto a board, mash it with seasoning and bottled citrus juice, then spread it onto bread and add two shaker seasonings.
goal.final_state: Bread slices are covered with mashed avocado and visible seasoning flakes.
procedure: Cut around the avocado and twist its halves apart.
Remove the pit and scrape flesh from both skins onto the board with a spoon.
Collect a fork and seasoning, then mash the avocado on the board.
Squeeze bottled citrus juice over the mash and mix it through.
Bring bread from the toaster, spread the avocado over it and shake seasonings over the top.

phases.description: A knife cuts around the avocado, both hands twist it apart, and the pit is loosened and removed with the knife.
A spoon scrapes flesh from both halves onto the cutting board; the skins are repeatedly scraped clean and put aside.
Utensils are cleared, a fork is retrieved from a drawer, and a small seasoning jar is opened. The fork repeatedly presses and breaks up the avocado on the board.
A green citrus-juice bottle is retrieved; after further mashing its contents are squeezed over the avocado and stirred through with the fork.
Bread is lifted from the toaster area and covered with forkfuls of avocado. A dark shaker and then a white-capped flake-seasoning bottle are shaken over the bread.
